description: Source code for the search layer of the Mattermost server, defining the SearchStore class and related functions for indexing users and channels.

classes.name: SearchStore
classes.description: A struct that encapsulates search-related data and methods for the Mattermost server, including user, team, channel, post, and file info stores, as well as search engine integration.

methods.name: NewSearchLayer
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new SearchStore instance with initialized stores and search engine.

methods.name: UpdateConfig
methods.description: Updates the configuration used by the search store.

methods.name: indexUserFromID
methods.description: Indexes a user based on their ID, fetching user data and calling indexUser.

methods.name: indexUser
methods.description: Indexes a user in all active search engines, including their team and channel memberships.

methods.name: indexChannelsForTeam
methods.description: Indexes all public channels for a given team, including team members.

methods.name: runIndexFn
methods.description: Runs an indexing function synchronously or asynchronously depending on the search engine's configuration.
